description: Charged annual 10% Straight-Line Method (SLM) depreciation on shop plant & machinery valued at book cost ₹4,00,000
narration: Being annual 10% SLM depreciation charged on plant & machinery asset
explanation: Non-cash operating expense reducing asset carrying value: Debit Depreciation Expense A/c Dr ₹40,000, Credit Plant & Machinery A/c Cr ₹40,000.

description: Charged 10% annual depreciation on office wooden furniture and showroom fixtures valued at ₹90,000 at year end
narration: Being 10% annual depreciation charged on office furniture asset
explanation: Debit Depreciation Expense A/c Dr ₹9,000 (charging expense to current year), Credit Furniture & Fixtures Asset A/c Cr ₹9,000.

description: Charged annual 40% IT Act rate depreciation on billing computers and server equipment (cost ₹1,50,000)
narration: Being 40% annual depreciation charged on office computers & IT equipment
explanation: Computers depreciate at higher rate (40%): Debit Depreciation Expense A/c Dr ₹60,000, Credit Computer Equipment A/c Cr ₹60,000.

description: Charged 15% annual depreciation on motor delivery van valued at ₹3,20,000 at year end
narration: Being 15% annual depreciation charged on commercial motor delivery van
explanation: Vehicle wear and tear: Debit Depreciation Expense A/c Dr ₹48,000, Credit Motor Vehicle Asset A/c Cr ₹48,000.

description: Charged 6 months proportionate 10% annual depreciation on new factory equipment ₹2,00,000 purchased on 01-Oct-2026 (6/12 months = ₹10,000)
narration: Being 6 months proportionate 10% annual depreciation charged on equipment acquired mid-year
explanation: Pro-rata Rule: Assets purchased mid-year are depreciated only for period used (₹2,00,000 * 10% * 6/12 = ₹10,000).

description: Transferred total year-end depreciation expense (₹40k + ₹9k + ₹60k + ₹48k + ₹10k = ₹1,67,000) to Profit & Loss Account
narration: Being total annual depreciation expense transferred to Profit & Loss Account to close nominal account
explanation: Closing Entry: Debit Profit & Loss A/c Dr ₹1,67,000 (reducing net profit), Credit Depreciation Expense A/c Cr ₹1,67,000 (closing expense account).

description: Charged 5% annual depreciation on factory building valued at book cost ₹10,00,000
narration: Being 5% annual depreciation charged on factory building asset
explanation: Building Depreciation: Debit Depreciation Expense A/c ₹50,000, Credit Factory Building Asset A/c ₹50,000.

description: Charged 15% annual depreciation on shop display racks and showroom counters cost ₹60,000
narration: Being 15% annual depreciation charged on showroom fixtures
explanation: Showroom Fixtures Depreciation: Debit Depreciation Expense A/c ₹9,000, Credit Showroom Fixtures A/c ₹9,000.

description: Charged 3 months proportionate 15% annual depreciation on office air conditioner ₹40,000 purchased on 01-Jan-2027 (3/12 months = ₹1,500)
narration: Being 3 months proportionate 15% depreciation charged on AC acquired in 4th quarter
explanation: Pro-rata 3 Months: Debit Depreciation Expense A/c ₹1,500, Credit Office AC Asset A/c ₹1,500.

description: Charged annual amortization of 20% on accounting ERP software license cost ₹50,000
narration: Being 20% annual amortization charged on software intangible asset
explanation: Intangible Amortization: Debit Amortization Expense A/c ₹10,000, Credit Software License Asset A/c ₹10,000.
